statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-118370 is a signed integer overflow in storeAtts() in libexpat's lib/xmlparse.c, affecting libexpat through 2.9.0: a start tag with more than 2^30 attributes overflows attIndex and nPrefixes and leads to out-of-bounds writes. libexpat 2.10.0 fixes it with the two commits of https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1450, https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/621cb2c78b253ee023a86bc91d6ddb048481c04c and https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/1bac53c4fc460a03cd9860f39501c7979f6750ae, both contained in the R_2_10_0 release tag. For Alpine 3.23, 2.10.0-r1 is the first build of libexpat 2.10.0 in the DHI repository; no 2.10.0-r0 is published. Every earlier published build (2.7.3-r0 to 2.9.0-r1) is libexpat 2.9.0 or older. Checked the libexpat.a static library in every published expat-static package for x86_64 and aarch64: storeAtts() in the x86_64 2.10.0-r1 builds has one more 64-bit comparison against INT_MAX than in any earlier build, matching the check the fix adds, and no earlier build carries a backport.

CVE-2026-118370 is a signed integer overflow in storeAtts() in libexpat's lib/xmlparse.c, affecting libexpat through 2.9.0: a start tag with more than 2^30 attributes overflows attIndex and nPrefixes and leads to out-of-bounds writes. libexpat 2.10.0 fixes it with the two commits of https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1450, https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/621cb2c78b253ee023a86bc91d6ddb048481c04c and https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/1bac53c4fc460a03cd9860f39501c7979f6750ae, both contained in the R_2_10_0 release tag. Debian has not fixed trixie (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-118370 lists 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 as vulnerable). This owner backports both commits onto Debian's 2.9.0-1~deb13u1, starting with the second build of that Debian version, which is the fixed version of this range; the third and fourth builds carry it too. Checked every libexpat1 and libexpat1-dev package published in the DHI Debian repository for amd64 and arm64: in those three builds the changelog records the backport and storeAtts() in the shipped libexpat.a has the INT_MAX check the fix adds (also confirmed in the shared libexpat.so.1 through its debug symbols for the second and fourth builds), while the first 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 build lacks it. Every earlier build is libexpat 2.8.3 or older with no changelog entry for this CVE, and sorts on the affected side of this range.
